notes: Job Agent 2.9.0 introduces the selected light desktop design: sidebar navigation, a readable vacancy table, a detail inspector with scores and reasons, separate profile/settings/update controls, favorites, translated filters and one-click log copying. Narrow windows place details below the table. Desktop now defaults to search-only: search, score and save vacancies without a CV or application forms, then prepare a selected vacancy explicitly. Uncheck 'Только поиск' for search-and-prepare runs. Existing contacts, CV paths, custom thresholds and confirmed history are preserved. Source badges distinguish results, partial errors, loading failures and zero parsed vacancies; StartupJobs diagnostics include HTTP and browser results. Location-only employer values such as Prague are rejected and explicit entry vacancies receive browser-evidence priority. Sent vacancies cannot re-enter the ready-to-apply filter. Final employer Submit remains manual. Validation includes 29 offline tests with actual Qt widgets, prior smoke checks and wide/narrow layout inspection.
